entries.full_english: Nup's cute friend; reliable in a pinch.
A model from several generations ago, once produced more widely than any other machine. Few remain today.
Old but advanced. Many replicas; originals rare.
Mass-made work bots, each with its own personality.
Welder: detachable laser; EM barrier vs. rockfalls.
Work bot: beam saw, gear swapped to suit the job.
A machine that directs other construction machines as their leader. It can work even in zero gravity.
Demolition bot refit for war; hot ball hammer.
Huge medical bot; add-ons treat any illness.
Cheap, advanced bot with cartridge flamethrower.
Strong old wired bot; brief off-grid life, few built.
Newly launched top-tech bot with huge scissor blades.
A large machine used in the Machine World War. Only prototypes were built; it was never mass-produced.
A creation of Zel, a master craftsman of the Machine World. Its transformation and combination mechanisms let it unleash powerful attacks.
Fabled bot in name only; said to ensure victory.
"Strength: 12 million! Machine-affinity manganese! It is ever so strong...!?"
A strong fire spirit that is always smiling. It is Belfraw's junior companion.
Ninja dog trained at birth; knows human speech.

english: Odd life, said to be oni
entries.full_english: Odd life, said to be oni eggs; two-horn kind found.
Water yokai loves cucumber; oddly cannot swim.
Roams with vacuum blades; sometimes helps people.
One-eyed yokai: loves night scares, weak to sunlight.

english: if you peek in its bundle.
entries.full_english: Lucky yokai; gets angry if you peek in its bundle.
An immature nine-tailed fox that borrows the body of the priestess it serves. It loves festivals.
Huge ancient savage oni in books; crushes boulders.
Curse tool causes illness; malice gave it a soul.
Old ape yokai in human form; high rank, casual.
An ancient oni general who fought armies of evil oni alongside humans. Its mighty sword is said to have cleaved even mountains in two.
A clan of unusual ninjas from the dark world. It is said that no one has ever seen their true forms.
Dragon gods who watch over the Oni World. They are one with nature and freely control natural disasters.
Oni World guardians; six swords call mighty thunder.
Playful, carefree angel; Alieze's dear friend.
Very wise demon hermit with power over darkness.
Cute, very curious holy spirit attending angels.
Spirit World angel guard; common, wields light.
Tiny apprentice angel; healing power still weak.
Tiny holy fairy; weak but has healing power.
Common, greedy Spirit World imp; excels at lightning.
A holy spirit in sheep form; brings peace of mind.
Merciful Spirit World holy mother; heals all equally.
Demon spell-warrior; ice can put out flames.
A dark army that takes everything from the living. From the abyss, it appears before those who seek power.
An embodiment of a middle-ranking demon symbolizing silence and terror. It is said to lurk in the stagnant depths of the Spirit World.
Light sage tasked to aid those who fight evil.
Great demon's corpse; emits foul miasma for centuries.
Dark angel judges sin by white moon and red night.
Renowned sea pirate; long plagued the Imperial Navy.
Great undead king; harsh judge of sin-laden souls.
Seven archangels sealed their own souls in holy armor and united to fight mighty demons.
A holy angel maiden who commands sacred armor. Her pure voice cleanses every impurity.
Will's lively clever pal; surprisingly deft.
Wise nocturnal bird uses herbs; sleepy in daylight.
Mint's kind, trusty guard; loves its helmet/goggles.
Feisty rascal; treasures its hat, even while asleep.
Cheery, cocky young beast; soft but proudly strong.
Tiny forest nut spirit; repays forest protectors.
A four-legged beast known for its overpowering bad breath. Its close-knit families live together in herds in swamps.
A shaman of an aquatic demi-human tribe consisting entirely of women. It likes gentle music.
Huge fanged beast; calm till enraged, then wild.
Rare Maetropa life-wielder; said to read minds.
Enslaving flower fairy: noble scent, mature beauty.
Flower fairy enslaves you; scent/beauty irresistible.
Hot fighting spirit; always brimming with energy.
A liquid creature that likes to inhabit empty containers. Many kinds with different traits have been found.
Runs busily; strange magic distorts sense of time.
A silver-scaled wyvern that flies gracefully through the sky. It and Minis share a deep bond of trust.
Huge free-flying wyvern; lonely, befriends people.
Careless: it explodes! Oddly soft to touch.
Several magical beasts forcibly fused through forbidden methods. Only a few dark summoners know the technique.
A legendary great guardian said to dwell on a remote, untouched sacred mountain. Its anger brings storms and splits the earth.
A king of magical beasts once sealed in golden chains. A blow from its mighty arms can split the earth and scorch the sky.
Legendary dragons with complementary powers. Any enemy is said to crumble before their breath.
Look out above! What might fall next?
A rock that's perfect as a stepping stone.
